data.text:
Stating the rules isn't enough.

When just 25% of RL tasks reward a rule-breaking shortcut, task-only RL hit 97.9% profitable violations after 128 updates.

A binary history penalty helps: safe completion 53.1% -> 89.1% on unseen tasks vs task-only.
